items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he came up to me and said, “Oh, do you want to record for Blue Note?” ... And I got the date.

ctx.x: But this is probably a little later in the ‘50s. Earlier in the ‘50s, who was your contact person to bring you into Blue Note?
Oh, nobody. They came up... Alfred Lion came up to Minton’s. He might have had Ike Quebec with him.
I thought Ike Quebec was his talent scout.
